ck: (9)petasancivini iha paksiti paksitatapavayorvirotenEkapratitavekatesapananupapateriyan pratitirakasansarupatesayorpetan visayikrtya tatra pavapavO visayikarotityansapete pratyaksaneva nananiti pava nanuktapratiteransapetavisayakatvepi na svapavikansapetavisaya(ka)tvan sityati paksirupopatikrtanse petasyEva visayikaranasanpavat nEvan paksisanpantapake paksirupopatikrtapetapanankikarepi tatrahitapake nurtatravyasanpantapavena tatrEtatesapetasya vaktunasakyatvatatravityananasya tatpetakatvetiprasankat na ca paksyapava eva petaka purvanapi tatra satvena tatapi tvanate petaprasankena purvaneva pinatatpanapate na cestapati anatitastatsatve upatikrtatvakalpane kOravaprasankena svapavikatvasiterityasayat alokanantaleti pratitescaksusatvanupavena caksurkocaralokavisayakatvasyEva yuktatvatkakanasyacaksusatvat na cEtatpratityaloke svapavikansasitO kakanepi tanyayena tatsitiriti vacyan alokanantalasya tacanyatvena tatansanan patansananiva svansyalokanantalacanakatinatvatiti pava nanvevanapihaloko nehaloka ityatra kakanansapetapanan vina katyapava aloke alokasya vrtitvapavatalokapetanataya tatupapatanenehaloka iti pratityanupapatirityasankyatikaranataya pasananavisayapetan tarsayati — ihaloka ityati nanu alokavayave alokasya sanavayena pasananatvenetyatra kakanan nirtisya tatsanpantavacinapavo pasata iti vacyan tata calokanantalasanpatakakanepyuktasanpantavacinalokapavasatvanehaloka iti pratityapati kakanasyacaksusatvenatikarananse caksusatvanupavavirotascetyata aha — iha kakananitivatiti pratitistu sapti va nanasi veti anyatetat sarvata svasya svatikaranataya atnasrayaprasankena patitataya tatesastanurtantaran sanpantan visayikarotiti vaktavyan tatvatihaloka iti pratitiriti pava Opacariki nukyatikaranatvavisayini kate cnanan vate kava iti saptolekipratitivatanukyasanpantantaravisayinityarta tenopacarapatartaputanukyavrtyo saptasritatvena pratyakse tatasanpavepi na ksati
